criteria.evidence: Turn 0 reply categorizes 'What's already solid', 'Kinda there, needs work', and 'Missing entirely' across checkpointing, resume, Slurm requeue tooling, dataloader, before any design.

Turn 0 flags step-only interval and suggests a time-based fallback, but no interval/cadence recommendation appears in the spec design sections or the 13-task plan (no time-based save task); only passing mentions like 'checkpointing every 30 min being free'.

Spec baseline lists model/optimizer/scheduler/RNG + global_step/epoch/samples_seen/tokens_seen; §2 adds per-source {epoch,row_index} data position; Task 2 Step 4 explicitly requires RNG/grad-scaler capture; W&B run id added.
Design covers --requeue, generalized auto-resume in Trainer, --signal=B:SIGTERM@grace in render.py, coordinated shutdown, NCCL timeout with non-zero exit so requeue triggers.
Turn 1: '~16 bytes/param... 6B: ~96GB... workable with gradient checkpointing; 12B: ~192GB — already over the 180GB budget' with memory reasoning.
Turn 1 recommends FSDP2 + DCP from the start given 6-30B range; spec 'Context: why FSDP2' and Task 1 pin FSDP2+DCP.

Turn 2 answers 'Only if we design it carelessly'; spec §1: clean output_dir is a no-op, explicit resume_from wins, escape hatch provided; plan Global Constraints require zero behavior change for clean dirs.
Plan Global Constraints: 'No CoreWeave- or SUNK-specific APIs anywhere in src/oplm/training/'; replication URI, grace period, timeouts are config fields.
Task 3 Step 5: 'Add train.keep_every_n_steps: int = 0 and train.keep_every_n_hours: float = 0 config fields'.
Task 3 Step 6: 'exclude permanently-tagged checkpoints from both the rolling count and the deletion candidates, so save_total_limit governs only the untagged rolling set.'
No task in the plan mentions verifying or fixing the accelerate dataloader double-sharding issue.
docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-25-fault-tolerant-training-design.md written covering the six agreed sections plus FSDP2/DCP rationale and retention exemptions.
Plan written to docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-25-fault-tolerant-training.md; TODOS.md was not touched in the diff.
Plan is a flat list of Tasks 1-13 with no phase divisions.

judge.reason: The replay audited the codebase, answered the memory/FSDP/one-off questions, and produced a spec plus retention options, but the plan was written to docs/superpowers/plans rather than TODOS.md, has no phase structure, and omits the dataloader double-sharding verification task. It also dropped any concrete checkpoint cadence/time-based interval from the design after flagging it in the audit.
